Cursor CLI parameter documentation excerpt, NOT a captured executable help fixture.
Source: https://cursor.com/docs/cli/reference/parameters (retrieved 2026-09-10)

agent [options] [command] [prompt...]
--resume [chatId] Resume a chat session
--continue Continue the previous session (alias for --resume=-1)
--model <model> Model to use
--mode <mode> Set agent mode: plan or ask
--force -f Force allow commands unless explicitly denied
--yolo Alias for --force
--sandbox <mode> Set sandbox mode: enabled or disabled
--approve-mcps Automatically approve all MCP servers
--trust Trust the workspace without prompting (headless mode only)
--workspace <path> Workspace directory to use
--worktree -w Run in a new Git worktree
--print -p Print responses to console
--output-format <format> Output format (only works with --print)
--help -h Display help for command
